name: Brownie
gmNotes: Brownie is a fey role, not a Species; this card is linked to the Brownie Archetype. expertRegions remains the campaign's home region (Ireland) as a provisional choice. Images remain empty pending art direction.
deepLore: Brownies wear ragged brown clothes. They are often linked to a fireplace, secretly perform household chores, and are traditionally paid in milk or cream. They may leave when offered clothes or a meal.
description: A helpful but capricious and elusive household spirit who works while the family sleeps.
feyKnowledge: Brownies are lower-ranking domestic helper-Fey. They usually perform household chores in exchange for milk, cream, and honey used to feed Takelings and human-derived clones. Most work for a laboratory or milk hub. Their brown caps are dust-and-smoke filters like those worn by Boggarts. Direct payment, gifts, formal naming, or explicit gratitude-settlement may break or terminate the household contract, explaining why a Brownie may leave when offered clothes, a meal, or a name. Many Brownies dislike Hobs and consider them arrogant; others aspire to become Hobs, though few succeed.
unlockGuidance: Deep Lore: household elders, storytellers, or Granny may know brownie customs; if feyLoreUnlocksDeepLore is set and the party has Fey Lore, grant Deep Lore at first discovery. Fey Knowledge: reveal through a mission, revelation, or a domestic helper-Fey — asking a Fey may require a Bargain or Grace consequences.
commonKnowledge: Brownies or Hobs are helpful but capricious and elusive household spirits who perform work while the family sleeps.
